_meta.extraction_provenance: Every value below names the sheet region it was read from. Regions: 'C18-vert' = Case 18's vertical (north-south) street, left half of sheet, top; 'C18-horiz' = Case 18's horizontal (east-west) street, left half, middle band; 'C18-departure' = the opposing-approach / departure sign sets flanking the intersection; 'key' = the '* Key to Advance Signing Distances' table, bottom right; 'legend' = right-edge legend column; 'notes' = the Case 18 Notes block, bottom left.

case_18.title: Typical Application - Traffic Control Around a Work Area Near an Intersection, One Lane Closed
case_18.title_provenance: Case 18 caption block, bottom-left of the left half (verbatim, three lines under 'Case No. 18').

scenario.shape: corner-quadrant work area at the intersection of two two-way streets; the hatched Work Area symbol sits at the corner, inside the curb returns, with Type III barricades closing it off
scenario.shape_provenance: C18-horiz/C18-vert junction: hatched box at the SE corner of the drawn intersection with 'TYPE III BARRICADE' callouts and '10' MIN.' lateral clearances
scenario.side: right lane of each feeding approach closed

feeding_approach_closure_train.provenance: Two trains drawn, one per street feeding the corner. C18-horiz (eastbound, drawn left-to-right): W20-1, R2-10, W20-5(R), W4-2(R) with gap markers *C (with *1/2C sub-dimension to R2-10), *B, *A, then VARIES (buffer) and L (merging taper, drum symbols) into the work area. C18-vert (southbound, drawn top-to-bottom): W20-1, *C, W20-5(R), *B, R2-10, *A, W4-2(R), then L, 100' to the corner.
feeding_approach_closure_train.r2_10_position_note: On the horizontal train R2-10 is dimensioned *1/2C inside the outermost W20-1; on the vertical train it is drawn between the B and A gaps. The two drawings disagree on R2-10's slot - drawing liberty on a not-to-scale plate. The tool follows the 1/2C reading (the increment-2 anchor), which is also Case 11's R2-10 convention.
feeding_approach_closure_train.taper: L (merging taper, drums) per the legend formula: L = S x W at >= 45 mph, WS^2/60 at <= 40 mph
feeding_approach_closure_train.taper_provenance: legend: 'Transition Taper Length' block; drum symbols along the taper per the small-square channelizing-device legend
feeding_approach_closure_train.buffer_provenance: C18-horiz dimension label between *A and L; legend maps VARIES to 'Buffer Space (see General Note 23 on Sheet 2)'. KNOWN UPSTREAM DISCREPANCY (do not correct, per standing memory note): the buffer note on Sheet 2 is actually note 24; the legend's 17/23 references are S-630-1's own error.

opposing_approach_advance_set.provenance: C18-departure: on each street's opposing (non-feeding) approach the plate draws W20-1 (ROAD WORK AHEAD) then R2-10 (BEGIN DOUBLE FINES ZONE), dimensioned 500' + 500' approaching the intersection, with R2-11 (END DOUBLE FINES ZONE) 100' past the intersection on the departure side. Read on the vertical street's northbound approach (dimension column '100' / 500' / 500'' right of the southbound lanes) and mirrored on the horizontal street.
opposing_approach_advance_set.key_reading: The drawn 500'/500' equals the RURAL key row (A = B = C = 500) read as: R2-10 at A from the crossing, W20-1 at 2A. Per Sheet 10 Note 1 the drawn dims typify RURAL placement; other road types substitute their key row (urban <= 40: A = 100; urban >= 45: A = 350). The 100' departure R2-11 is a fixed dimension, not keyed.

advance_signing_key.provenance: '* Key to Advance Signing Distances' table, bottom right of the sheet, verbatim

notes_verbatim: 1. Sign placement shown on cases 18 and 19 typifies rural applications. Urban applications require the signs to be placed within one, or perhaps two, blocks.
2. Truck-mounted attenuators (TMA) optional for all cases as determined by the Engineer.
case_18.notes_provenance: Notes block under the Case 18 caption (verbatim; note 1 is the 'Sheet 10 Note 1' already cited by the sheet's urban-placement disclosure fine print)

fines_double_envelope.provenance: star symbols on R2-10/R2-11 throughout; legend: 'See Fines Double Signing Notes On Sheet 12'
fines_double_envelope.note: R2-10/R2-11 carry the star marker on every drawn set - envelope semantics come from Sheet 12, matched per the existing match_rules Fines Double section, not re-asserted here.

other_devices.type_iii_barricades: close the corner work area (provenance: 'TYPE III BARRICADE' callouts at the hatched area)
other_devices.flashing_beacons: sunburst symbol on W20-1/W20-4/W20-5(R)/W4-2(R)/W20-7 warning signs (provenance: legend 'Flashing Beacon'; triangle = optional device)
other_devices.mobile_attenuator: drawn on the horizontal approach upstream of the taper with the optional triangle (provenance: C18-horiz, TMA symbol; notes item 2 makes it engineer-optional)

exact_match_required: feeding-train sign codes W20-1, R2-10, W20-5(R), W4-2(R) on the tool's mainline (the one street the tool models)
opposing-set sign codes W20-1, R2-10 + departure R2-11 on each cross-street leg, at key-scaled stations (R2-10 at A from the curb line, W20-1 at 2A, R2-11 at 100' departure side)
R2-10 at 1/2C inside the outermost mainline sign (the horizontal-train reading)
informational_only_not_assertions: drawn device counts along tapers (diagram-illustrative; actual counts by spacing rules)
the vertical train's alternate R2-10 slot (see r2_10_position_note)
validation_notes.documented_departures: see match_rules.md 'Case 18 (near_intersection)' - three departures, disclosed on every rendered surface
